meaning: Stable tooth identifier and numbering convention
recording_rule: Record numbering system and tooth identity

meaning: Surface or internal region being reconstructed
recording_rule: Separate visible and hidden regions

meaning: Tissue or interface required in this region
values_or_units: enamel; dentin; DEJ; pulp; cementum; PDL; bone; gingiva
recording_rule: Keep tissue identity separate from shape

meaning: Private asset or record supporting the target
recording_rule: Do not embed personal images or identifiers in public records

meaning: Kind of historical or inferred evidence
values_or_units: 3d_scan; cast; photograph; clinical_record; surviving_anatomy; contralateral_prior; population_prior
recording_rule: A prior is not an individual historical measurement

meaning: Date or interval of source capture
recording_rule: Unknown remains unknown

meaning: Whether metric dimensions are supported
recording_rule: Uncalibrated photograph pixels do not establish millimetres

meaning: Coverage of this target region
recording_rule: Hidden enamel thickness and internal anatomy require additional evidence

meaning: How the regional target was obtained
recording_rule: Never upgrade an inferred target to a measured original

meaning: Controlled reference to target surface or volume
recording_rule: Preserve source-to-target reconstruction history

meaning: Controlled reference to current surface or volume
recording_rule: Current restorative material is a separate compartment

meaning: Target thickness relative to measured or inferred DEJ
recording_rule: Record position, measurement method and uncertainty; photos alone are insufficient

meaning: Target regional dentin volume
recording_rule: Do not combine enamel and dentin into one biological endpoint

meaning: Estimated physical enamel deficit
recording_rule: Record registration and segmentation uncertainty

meaning: Estimated physical dentin deficit
recording_rule: Keep restorative material separate from native dentin

meaning: Material type and extent of any existing restoration
recording_rule: No automatic removal is implied

meaning: Record of crack extent and assessment method
recording_rule: Visible surface continuity does not establish internal integrity

meaning: Region-specific error estimate or uncertainty envelope
recording_rule: State sources including scale, pose, segmentation and hidden-region inference

meaning: Separately governed history of reported damage mechanism
recording_rule: Do not infer cause or treatment necessity from photographs

meaning: Whether the target is sufficiently supported for a stated use
recording_rule: State the intended use; geometry support is not tissue-regeneration evidence
